controlFields.name: VERSION
controlFields.description: SD/FS memory layout version (MIA_SD_VERSION).

controlFields.name: STATUS
controlFields.description: SD/FS status flags (MIA_SD_STATUS_*).

controlFields.name: LAST_ERROR
controlFields.description: Last MIA SD/FS error code, or zero.

controlFields.name: CARD_TYPE
controlFields.description: Card type (MIA_SD_CARD_*).

controlFields.name: LBA
controlFields.description: Sector address for raw sector commands, little-endian.

controlFields.name: REQUEST_LEN
controlFields.description: Byte count for FS_READ and FS_WRITE, or the most FS_LOAD_TO_MIA_RAM loads.

controlFields.name: RESULT_LEN
controlFields.description: Bytes the last transfer produced.

controlFields.name: DEST_ADDR
controlFields.description: MIA RAM address for FS_LOAD_TO_MIA_RAM, FS_SAVE_FROM_MIA_RAM and FS_LOAD_PART.

controlFields.name: FILE_HANDLE
controlFields.description: 1 when the slot HANDLE_SELECT names is open, otherwise 0.

controlFields.name: OPEN_MODE
controlFields.description: How FS_OPEN opens the selected slot (MIA_FS_OPEN_*).

controlFields.name: EOF
controlFields.description: Nonzero when the selected slot's file is at its end; with no file open there, the last directory read or load/save job's end.

controlFields.name: FATFS_RESULT
controlFields.description: FatFs's FRESULT code from the last filesystem operation.

controlFields.name: FLAGS
controlFields.description: Write zero.

controlFields.name: CARD_SECTORS
controlFields.description: Card capacity in 512-byte sectors, when known.

controlFields.name: FILE_SIZE
controlFields.description: Size of the selected slot's open file.

controlFields.name: FILE_POS
controlFields.description: Selected slot's file position; written before FS_SEEK. After FS_LOAD_TO_MIA_RAM, the bytes loaded.

controlFields.name: FREE_CLUSTERS
controlFields.description: Free FAT clusters, after FS_GET_FREE.

controlFields.name: TOTAL_CLUSTERS
controlFields.description: Usable FAT clusters, after FS_GET_FREE.

controlFields.name: CLUSTER_SECTORS
controlFields.description: Sectors per FAT cluster, after FS_GET_FREE.

controlFields.name: TRANSFER_LEN
controlFields.description: Byte count for FS_SAVE_FROM_MIA_RAM, and bytes per row for FS_LOAD_PART.

controlFields.name: HANDLE_SELECT
controlFields.description: File slot, 0-15, that FS_OPEN, FS_READ, FS_WRITE, FS_SEEK, FS_SYNC and FS_CLOSE act on.

controlFields.name: PART_OFFSET
controlFields.description: FS_LOAD_PART: file offset of the first byte.

controlFields.name: PART_ROWS
controlFields.description: FS_LOAD_PART: number of rows; 0 loads one contiguous run.

controlFields.name: PART_FILE_STRIDE
controlFields.description: FS_LOAD_PART: bytes from one row to the next in the file.

controlFields.name: PART_RAM_STRIDE
controlFields.description: FS_LOAD_PART: bytes from one row to the next in MIA RAM.

statusBits.name: INITIALIZED
statusBits.description: The SD block driver is initialized.

statusBits.name: BUSY
statusBits.description: An SD/FS command is in progress.

statusBits.name: FILE_OPEN
statusBits.description: The slot HANDLE_SELECT names is open.

statusBits.name: EOF
statusBits.description: Same condition as the EOF field.

cardTypes.name: SDHC
cardTypes.description: High-capacity card (SDHC or SDXC) using block addressing.

openModes.name: READ
openModes.description: Open an existing file for reading.

openModes.name: WRITE_CREATE
openModes.description: Create or truncate a file for writing.

openModes.name: WRITE_APPEND
openModes.description: Create the file if missing and append at its end.

openModes.name: READ_WRITE
openModes.description: Open or create a file for updates in place.

dirEntryFields.name: NAME_LEN
dirEntryFields.description: Length of the name; 0 with EOF set means the directory is exhausted.

dirAttributeBits.name: HIDDEN
dirAttributeBits.description: The entry is hidden from normal listings.

dirAttributeBits.name: SYSTEM
dirAttributeBits.description: The entry belongs to the operating system.

dirAttributeBits.name: VOLUME_LABEL
dirAttributeBits.description: The entry is the volume label, not a file.

dirAttributeBits.name: ARCHIVE
dirAttributeBits.description: The entry changed since the last backup.

loadPartCommand.effect: loads rows of SD_TRANSFER_LEN bytes; row r is read from offset + r*fileStride and written to destination + r*ramStride; rows 0 loads one contiguous run; EOF ends the load early and still succeeds
